decisions.reason: As a niche but adjacent waterproof lined safety-shoe range, it likely shares components and channels with the core business, so management would keep the option open unless sales have clearly disappointed.
An electrostatic-dissipative occupational shoe addresses a defined industrial niche in the firm's core market, and the cost of continuing it is likely low relative to its potential upside.
A safety shoe series is close to the established product base, so if it is still being carried into 2022 the firm would typically continue it unless accumulated results strongly point to weak demand.
